name: Audio
description: Exposes macOS audio as live MCP resources that push on change: output volume/mute (resource://audio/output), input (mic) volume/mute (resource://audio/input), and the device inventory with each device's live volume/mute + current defaults (resource://audio/devices). Tools: get/set output & input volume + mute (targeting the default device or any specific device by UID), and list / switch the default output & input device.
